title: Correctness at every bounded time
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-tape Turing machine with Boolean symbols, let $x$ be a finite Boolean input, let $A$ be a Boolean answer table, and let $x_b$ be a Boolean sequence agreeing with $x$ at every index below $|x|$. Suppose every local check passes under the numerical valuation determined by $M,A,W,x,x_b$ for all times and work indices below $2^W$, all input indices at most $|x|+1$, and every check type. Then for every $t<2^W$, the table answers all state-and-output queries correctly at time $t$, all work-tape queries correctly at offsets satisfying $|d|+t\le 2^W-1$, and all input queries correctly at offsets satisfying $|d|\le |x|+1$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite-tape Turing machine with Boolean symbols
A Boolean sequence agreeing with the input at indices below $|x|$
